timestamp_unit: pcapng interface ticks; deltas below converted at 1,000,000 ticks/s
ARM_WAIT_MODEL: one absolute monotonic host deadline beginning after validated final 0x32 ACK; wait exactly once for IRQ 0x0002; do not renew deadline on unmatched input; fail closed and perform host-only cleanup at expiration

ARM_WAIT_TIMEOUT_EVIDENCE.recommendation_basis: 15 s covers the sole primary-target positive delay with bounded margin; Rockytkg uses 15 s for finger-up waits only as corroborative scale, not target proof
ARM_WAIT_TIMEOUT_EVIDENCE.device_lifetime_claim: NONE; 15 s is a host deadline, not a device arm TTL

ALLOWED_INTERMEDIATE_EVENTS: USB transfer completion/wrapper frames that assemble the expected IRQ2 frame and do not represent a second semantic event
UNEXPECTED_INTERMEDIATE_EVENTS: any complete semantic A0 event other than IRQ 0x0002, any B0/TLS application record before 0x22, malformed frame, disconnect, or duplicate; fail closed without retry or device command
UNOBSERVED_BEHAVIOR: whether arm remains internally active after host timeout/close
proof_limits: one positive APP12509 trace cannot establish a lifetime distribution or internal TTL; D255/D256 no-finger traces establish re-entry/quiescence but not post-first-image state
